answer: The east tram brake may be held by one bonded brakeman, never a roster of remote stand-ins. The brakeman posts 27.9 POA for one numbered brake drum on the basalt ridge and must keep the shoes warm through a 5.5-hour descent window. Mid-run a lot-chosen inspector files a live copper shaving from the drum rim onto a damp tally, photographs the shaving beside the drum serial, and requires a signed hash of that pair within 19 seconds while the metal still smells of heat. A second-handed crew, a cold drum, or a late hash forfeits 8.7 POA and yields the brake.
